name: Lercanidipine
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 10 mg once daily at least 15 minutes before a meal; may increase to 20 mg after about 2 weeks; maximum 20 mg/day

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, erythromycin, clarithromycin)

key_interactions.action: Give lercanidipine in the morning and simvastatin in the evening.

contraindications: Severe kidney impairment (GFR <30 mL/min), including dialysis
Left ventricular outflow obstruction; untreated heart failure; unstable angina or myocardial infarction within 1 month
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, women of childbearing potential without contraception

pk.bioavailability: About 10% (fed; high first pass); a high-fat meal increases it about 4-fold
pk.half_life_eskd: Levels about 70% higher in severe impairment or dialysis
pk.protein_binding: Over 98% (lower in severe kidney or liver disease)
pk.active_metabolites: None (no parent drug in urine or feces)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 50% of dose in urine as metabolites

sources.citation: Accord Healthcare Ireland Ltd.. (2022). Lecalpin 10 mg film-coated tablets (lercanidipine hydrochloride) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA2315/186/001; text revised October 2022]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
